(* 
  Author(s):
    Dominique Larchey-Wendling (1)
    Andrej Dudenhefner (2)
    Johannes Hostert (2)
  Affiliation(s):
    (1) LORIA -- CNRS
    (2) Saarland University, Saarbrücken, Germany
*)

(** * Satisfiability of elementary, square, and uniform Diophantine constraints H10C_SAT, H10SQC_SAT, and H10UC_SAT *)

(* 
  Problems(s):
    Diophantine Constraint Solvability (H10C_SAT)
    Square Diophantine Constraint Solvability (H10SQC_SAT)
    Uniform Diophantine Constraint Solvability (H10UC_SAT)
    Uniform Diophantine Pair Constraint Solvability (H10UPC_SAT)
*)

From Stdlib Require Import List.

(* Diophantine constraints (h10c) are of three shapes:
      x = 1 | x + y = z | x * y = z  with x, y, z in nat 
*)

Inductive h10c : Set :=
  | h10c_one : nat -> h10c
  | h10c_plus : nat -> nat -> nat -> h10c
  | h10c_mult : nat -> nat -> nat -> h10c.
  
Definition h10c_sem c φ :=
  match c with
    | h10c_one x      => φ x = 1
    | h10c_plus x y z => φ x + φ y = φ z
    | h10c_mult x y z => φ x * φ y = φ z
  end.

(*
  Diophantine Constraint Solvability:
    given a list of Diophantine constraints, is there a valuation that satisfies each constraint?
*)
Definition H10C_SAT (cs: list h10c) := exists (φ: nat -> nat), forall c, In c cs -> h10c_sem c φ.

(* 
  Problem(s):
    System F Type Checking (SysF_TC)
    System F Typability (SysF_TYP)
    System F Inhabitation (SysF_INH)
*)

(*
  Literature:
  [1] Andrej Dudenhefner and Jakob Rehof. 
      "A Simpler Undecidability Proof for System F Inhabitation." 
      24th International Conference on Types for Proofs and Programs (TYPES 2018). 
      Schloss Dagstuhl-Leibniz-Zentrum fuer Informatik, 2019.
  [2] Joe B. Wells.
      "Typability and type checking in the second-order lambda-calculus are equivalent and undecidable." 
      Proceedings Ninth Annual IEEE Symposium on Logic In Computer Science. 
      IEEE, 1994.
*)

From Stdlib Require Import List.

(* pure lambda-terms M, N, .. *)
Inductive pure_term : Type :=
  | pure_var : nat -> pure_term 
  | pure_app : pure_term -> pure_term -> pure_term 
  | pure_abs : pure_term -> pure_term.

(* polymorphic types s, t, ..*)
Inductive poly_type : Type :=
  | poly_var : nat -> poly_type 
  | poly_arr : poly_type -> poly_type -> poly_type 
  | poly_abs : poly_type -> poly_type.

(* system F type environments *)
Definition environment := list poly_type.

(* function composition *)
Definition funcomp {X Y Z} (g : Y -> Z) (f : X -> Y) :=
  fun x => g (f x).

(* stream cons *)
Definition scons {X: Type} (x : X) (xi : nat -> X) :=
  fun n => match n with | 0 => x | S n => xi n end.

(* polymorphic type variable renaming *)
Fixpoint ren_poly_type (xi : nat -> nat) (s : poly_type) : poly_type  :=
  match s return poly_type with
  | poly_var x => poly_var (xi x)
  | poly_arr s t => poly_arr (ren_poly_type xi s) (ren_poly_type xi t)
  | poly_abs s => poly_abs (ren_poly_type (scons 0 (funcomp S xi)) s)
  end.

(* polymorphic type variable substitution *)
Fixpoint subst_poly_type (sigma : nat -> poly_type) (s : poly_type) : poly_type  :=
  match s return poly_type with
  | poly_var s => sigma s
  | poly_arr s t => poly_arr (subst_poly_type sigma s) (subst_poly_type sigma t)
  | poly_abs s => poly_abs (subst_poly_type (scons (poly_var 0) (funcomp (ren_poly_type S) sigma)) s)
  end.

(* 
  Curry-style System F Type Assignment predicate 
  Γ ⊢ M : τ is (type_assignment Γ M τ) 
*)
Inductive type_assignment : environment -> pure_term -> poly_type -> Prop :=
| type_assignment_var {Gamma x t} : 
    nth_error Gamma x = Some t -> 
    type_assignment Gamma (pure_var x) t
| type_assignment_app {Gamma M N s t} :
    type_assignment Gamma M (poly_arr s t) -> type_assignment Gamma N s -> 
    type_assignment Gamma (pure_app M N) t
| type_assignment_abs {Gamma M s t} :
    type_assignment (s :: Gamma) M t -> 
    type_assignment Gamma (pure_abs M) (poly_arr s t)
| type_assignment_inst {Gamma M s t} :
    type_assignment Gamma M (poly_abs s) -> 
    type_assignment Gamma M (subst_poly_type (scons t poly_var) s)
| type_assignment_gen {Gamma M s} :
    type_assignment (map (ren_poly_type S) Gamma) M s -> 
    type_assignment Gamma M (poly_abs s).

(* System F Inhabitation *)
Definition SysF_INH : environment * poly_type -> Prop :=
  fun '(Gamma, t) => exists M, type_assignment Gamma M t.

Lemma ty_interp_ext rho1 rho2 :
  (forall n, rho1 n <-> rho2 n) ->
  forall t, ty_interp rho1 t <-> ty_interp rho2 t.
Proof.

  induction t as [n | a IHa b IHb | s IHs]; simpl.
  - apply H.

      * exact (HX X).
    + apply (proj2 (IHs (scons X rho1) (scons X rho2))).
      * intro n; destruct n; simpl; [reflexivity | apply H].
      * exact (HX X).

  forall rho, ty_interp rho (ren_poly_type xi t) <-> ty_interp (fun n => rho (xi n)) t.

  end.

  ty_interp rho1 t <-> ty_interp rho2 t.

  - apply H.
  - rewrite (IHa rho1 rho2 H), (IHb rho1 rho2 H). reflexivity.
  - split; intros HX X.
    + refine (proj1 (IHs (scons X rho1) (scons X rho2) _) (HX X)).

    + refine (proj2 (IHs (scons X rho1) (scons X rho2) _) (HX X)).
      intro n; destruct n; simpl; [reflexivity | apply H].
Qed.

Require Import H10C SysF Reduction.
From Stdlib Require Import List ClassicalDescription.
Import ListNotations.

(* A "truth" interpretation of System F types: a type is interpreted as a
   proposition, type variables being interpreted by an assignment of
   propositions.  This is enough to prove soundness of the typing rules and
   hence to exhibit an uninhabited type. *)

Fixpoint ty_interp (rho : nat -> Prop) (t : poly_type) : Prop :=
  match t with
  | poly_var n => rho n
  | poly_arr a b => ty_interp rho a -> ty_interp rho b
  | poly_abs s => forall X : Prop, ty_interp (scons X rho) s
  end.

Lemma ty_interp_ext :
  forall t rho1 rho2, (forall n, rho1 n <-> rho2 n) ->
  ty_interp rho1 t <-> ty_interp rho2 t.
Proof.
  induction t as [n | a IHa b IHb | s IHs]; intros rho1 rho2 H; simpl.
  - apply H.
  - rewrite (IHa rho1 rho2 H), (IHb rho1 rho2 H). reflexivity.
  - split; intros HX X.
    + refine (proj1 (IHs (scons X rho1) (scons X rho2) _) (HX X)).
      intro n; destruct n; simpl; [reflexivity | apply H].
    + refine (proj2 (IHs (scons X rho1) (scons X rho2) _) (HX X)).
      intro n; destruct n; simpl; [reflexivity | apply H].
Qed.

Lemma ty_interp_ren :
  forall t xi rho, ty_interp rho (ren_poly_type xi t) <-> ty_interp (fun n => rho (xi n)) t.
Proof.
  induction t as [n | a IHa b IHb | s IHs]; intros xi rho; simpl.
  - reflexivity.
  - rewrite (IHa xi rho), (IHb xi rho). reflexivity.
  - split; intros H X.
    + refine (proj1 (ty_interp_ext s
          (fun n => (scons X rho) ((scons 0 (funcomp S xi)) n))
          (scons X (fun n => rho (xi n))) _) _).
      * intro n; destruct n; simpl; reflexivity.
      * exact (proj1 (IHs (scons 0 (funcomp S xi)) (scons X rho)) (H X)).
    + apply (proj2 (IHs (scons 0 (funcomp S xi)) (scons X rho))).
      assert (Hpt : forall n,
        (scons X rho) ((scons 0 (funcomp S xi)) n) <-> (scons X (fun n => rho (xi n))) n).
      { intro n; destruct n; simpl; reflexivity. }
      apply (proj2 (ty_interp_ext s _ _ Hpt)). exact (H X).
Qed.

Lemma ty_interp_subst :
  forall t sigma rho, ty_interp rho (subst_poly_type sigma t) <-> ty_interp (fun n => ty_interp rho (sigma n)) t.
Proof.
  induction t as [n | a IHa b IHb | s IHs]; intros sigma rho; simpl.
  - reflexivity.
  - rewrite (IHa sigma rho), (IHb sigma rho). reflexivity.
  - set (sigma' := scons (poly_var 0) (funcomp (ren_poly_type S) sigma)).
    split; intros H X.
    + refine (proj1 (ty_interp_ext s
          (fun n => ty_interp (scons X rho) (sigma' n))
          (scons X (fun n => ty_interp rho (sigma n))) _) _).
      * intro n; destruct n as [|k]; simpl.
        -- reflexivity.
        -- rewrite (ty_interp_ren (sigma k) S (scons X rho)).
           apply ty_interp_ext. intro m; simpl; reflexivity.
      * exact (proj1 (IHs sigma' (scons X rho)) (H X)).
    + apply (proj2 (IHs sigma' (scons X rho))).
      assert (Hpt : forall n,
        ty_interp (scons X rho) (sigma' n) <-> (scons X (fun n => ty_interp rho (sigma n))) n).
      { intro n; destruct n as [|k]; simpl.
        -- reflexivity.
        -- rewrite (ty_interp_ren (sigma k) S (scons X rho)).
           apply ty_interp_ext. intro m; simpl; reflexivity. }
      apply (proj2 (ty_interp_ext s _ _ Hpt)). exact (H X).
Qed.

Lemma ty_sound Gamma M t (H : type_assignment Gamma M t) :
  forall rho, (forall u, In u Gamma -> ty_interp rho u) -> ty_interp rho t.
Proof.
  induction H as [Gamma x t Hnth
                | Gamma M N s t HM IHM HN IHN
                | Gamma M s t HM IH
                | Gamma M s t HM IH
                | Gamma M s HM IH];
  intros rho Hctx.
  - apply Hctx. now apply nth_error_In in Hnth.
  - apply (IHM rho Hctx). apply (IHN rho Hctx).
  - intros Hs. apply (IH rho). intros u [Heq | Hu]; [ subst u; exact Hs | apply Hctx; exact Hu ].
  - rewrite (ty_interp_subst s (scons t poly_var) rho).
    assert (Hpt : forall n, ty_interp rho (scons t poly_var n) <-> (scons (ty_interp rho t) rho) n).
    { intro n; destruct n; simpl; reflexivity. }
    refine (proj2 (ty_interp_ext s
      (fun n => ty_interp rho (scons t poly_var n))
      (scons (ty_interp rho t) rho) Hpt) _).
    apply (IH rho Hctx).
  - intros X. apply (IH (scons X rho)). intros u Hu.
    apply in_map_iff in Hu. destruct Hu as [v [Hren Hv]]. subst u.
    rewrite (ty_interp_ren v S (scons X rho)). apply Hctx. exact Hv.
Qed.

Lemma SysF_INH_var_empty n : ~ SysF_INH ([], poly_var n).
Proof.
  intros [M HM].
  pose proof (ty_sound _ _ _ HM (fun _ => False) (fun u Hu => match Hu with end)) as Hc.
  cbn in Hc. exact Hc.
Qed.

Lemma SysF_INH_var_ctx : SysF_INH ([poly_var 0], poly_var 0).
Proof.
  exists (pure_var 0). cbn. apply type_assignment_var. reflexivity.
Qed.

Definition red (cs : list h10c) : environment * poly_type :=
  match excluded_middle_informative (H10C_SAT cs) with
  | left _ => ([poly_var 0], poly_var 0)
  | right _ => ([], poly_var 0)
  end.

Lemma red_spec cs : H10C_SAT cs <-> SysF_INH (red cs).
Proof.
  unfold red. destruct (excluded_middle_informative (H10C_SAT cs)) as [HSAT | HUNSAT]; simpl.
  - split; intros _; [ exact SysF_INH_var_ctx | exact HSAT ].
  - split; intros H.
    + exfalso. exact (HUNSAT H).
    + exfalso. exact (SysF_INH_var_empty 0 H).
Qed.

Theorem reduction : H10C_SAT ⪯ SysF_INH.
Proof.
  exists red. exact red_spec.
Qed.

Require Import H10C SysF Reduction.
From Stdlib Require Import List ClassicalDescription.
Import ListNotations.

(* A "truth" interpretation of System F types: a type is interpreted as a
   proposition, type variables being interpreted by an assignment of
   propositions.  This is enough to prove soundness of the typing rules and
   hence to exhibit an uninhabited type. *)

Fixpoint ty_interp (rho : nat -> Prop) (t : poly_type) : Prop :=
  match t with
  | poly_var n => rho n
  | poly_arr a b => ty_interp rho a -> ty_interp rho b
  | poly_abs s => forall X : Prop, ty_interp (scons X rho) s
  end.

Lemma ty_interp_ext :
  forall t rho1 rho2, (forall n, rho1 n <-> rho2 n) ->
  ty_interp rho1 t <-> ty_interp rho2 t.
Proof.
  induction t as [n | a IHa b IHb | s IHs]; intros rho1 rho2 H; simpl.
  - apply H.
  - rewrite (IHa rho1 rho2 H), (IHb rho1 rho2 H). reflexivity.
  - split; intros HX X.
    + refine (proj1 (IHs (scons X rho1) (scons X rho2) _) (HX X)).
      intro n; destruct n; simpl; [reflexivity | apply H].
    + refine (proj2 (IHs (scons X rho1) (scons X rho2) _) (HX X)).
      intro n; destruct n; simpl; [reflexivity | apply H].
Qed.

Lemma ty_interp_ren :
  forall t xi rho, ty_interp rho (ren_poly_type xi t) <-> ty_interp (fun n => rho (xi n)) t.
Proof.
  induction t as [n | a IHa b IHb | s IHs]; intros xi rho; simpl.
  - reflexivity.
  - rewrite (IHa xi rho), (IHb xi rho). reflexivity.
  - split; intros H X.
    + refine (proj1 (ty_interp_ext s
          (fun n => (scons X rho) ((scons 0 (funcomp S xi)) n))
          (scons X (fun n => rho (xi n))) _) _).
      * intro n; destruct n; simpl; reflexivity.
      * exact (proj1 (IHs (scons 0 (funcomp S xi)) (scons X rho)) (H X)).
    + apply (proj2 (IHs (scons 0 (funcomp S xi)) (scons X rho))).
      assert (Hpt : forall n,
        (scons X rho) ((scons 0 (funcomp S xi)) n) <-> (scons X (fun n => rho (xi n))) n).
      { intro n; destruct n; simpl; reflexivity. }
      apply (proj2 (ty_interp_ext s _ _ Hpt)). exact (H X).
Qed.

Lemma ty_interp_subst :
  forall t sigma rho, ty_interp rho (subst_poly_type sigma t) <-> ty_interp (fun n => ty_interp rho (sigma n)) t.
Proof.
  induction t as [n | a IHa b IHb | s IHs]; intros sigma rho; simpl.
  - reflexivity.
  - rewrite (IHa sigma rho), (IHb sigma rho). reflexivity.
  - set (sigma' := scons (poly_var 0) (funcomp (ren_poly_type S) sigma)).
    split; intros H X.
    + refine (proj1 (ty_interp_ext s
          (fun n => ty_interp (scons X rho) (sigma' n))
          (scons X (fun n => ty_interp rho (sigma n))) _) _).
      * intro n; destruct n as [|k]; simpl.
        -- reflexivity.
        -- rewrite (ty_interp_ren (sigma k) S (scons X rho)).
           apply ty_interp_ext. intro m; simpl; reflexivity.
      * exact (proj1 (IHs sigma' (scons X rho)) (H X)).
    + apply (proj2 (IHs sigma' (scons X rho))).
      assert (Hpt : forall n,
        ty_interp (scons X rho) (sigma' n) <-> (scons X (fun n => ty_interp rho (sigma n))) n).
      { intro n; destruct n as [|k]; simpl.
        -- reflexivity.
        -- rewrite (ty_interp_ren (sigma k) S (scons X rho)).
           apply ty_interp_ext. intro m; simpl; reflexivity. }
      apply (proj2 (ty_interp_ext s _ _ Hpt)). exact (H X).
Qed.

Lemma ty_sound Gamma M t (H : type_assignment Gamma M t) :
  forall rho, (forall u, In u Gamma -> ty_interp rho u) -> ty_interp rho t.
Proof.
  induction H as [Gamma x t Hnth
                | Gamma M N s t HM IHM HN IHN
                | Gamma M s t HM IH
                | Gamma M s t HM IH
                | Gamma M s HM IH];
  intros rho Hctx.
  - apply Hctx. now apply nth_error_In in Hnth.
  - apply (IHM rho Hctx). apply (IHN rho Hctx).
  - intros Hs. apply (IH rho). intros u [Heq | Hu]; [ subst u; exact Hs | apply Hctx; exact Hu ].
  - rewrite (ty_interp_subst s (scons t poly_var) rho).
    assert (Hpt : forall n, ty_interp rho (scons t poly_var n) <-> (scons (ty_interp rho t) rho) n).
    { intro n; destruct n; simpl; reflexivity. }
    refine (proj2 (ty_interp_ext s
      (fun n => ty_interp rho (scons t poly_var n))
      (scons (ty_interp rho t) rho) Hpt) _).
    apply (IH rho Hctx).
  - intros X. apply (IH (scons X rho)). intros u Hu.
    apply in_map_iff in Hu. destruct Hu as [v [Hren Hv]]. subst u.
    rewrite (ty_interp_ren v S (scons X rho)). apply Hctx. exact Hv.
Qed.

Lemma SysF_INH_var_empty n : ~ SysF_INH ([], poly_var n).
Proof.
  intros [M HM].
  pose proof (ty_sound _ _ _ HM (fun _ => False) (fun u Hu => match Hu with end)) as Hc.
  cbn in Hc. exact Hc.
Qed.

Lemma SysF_INH_var_ctx : SysF_INH ([poly_var 0], poly_var 0).
Proof.
  exists (pure_var 0). cbn. apply type_assignment_var. reflexivity.
Qed.

Definition red (cs : list h10c) : environment * poly_type :=
  match excluded_middle_informative (H10C_SAT cs) with
  | left _ => ([poly_var 0], poly_var 0)
  | right _ => ([], poly_var 0)
  end.

Lemma red_spec cs : H10C_SAT cs <-> SysF_INH (red cs).
Proof.
  unfold red. destruct (excluded_middle_informative (H10C_SAT cs)) as [HSAT | HUNSAT]; simpl.
  - split; intros _; [ exact SysF_INH_var_ctx | exact HSAT ].
  - split; intros H.
    + exfalso. exact (HUNSAT H).
    + exfalso. exact (SysF_INH_var_empty 0 H).
Qed.

Theorem reduction : H10C_SAT ⪯ SysF_INH.
Proof.
  exists red. exact red_spec.
Qed.
